{{Quote|Never again will we be left without weapons, without a fleet. Though Coruscant chooses to ignore this threat, we will fight for the glory of the Republic.|Empress Teta|<ref name="Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 1">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 1|''Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire'' 1]]</ref>}}
The '''Koros fleet''' was the military of the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Koros system]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. The force participated in the war against the anti-unification rebels on [[Kirrek]], and later in the Great Hyperspace War against the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].
